title: Virgin Atlantic
tagline: Iconic red/purple already strong; the home is dense and CTA-heavy. Variants test compositional rest and a deliberate purple in-body, vs the bold direction.

direction.phrase: Redesign this home page for presales (brand-faithful Mode A; three variants A/B/C).

palette.name: Virgin Atlantic brand-pinned
palette.source: inherited from stardust/current/_brand-extraction.json + photographic-purple token added

originalCritique: The brand surface is iconic but the homepage carries it badly. Three display jumps with no consistent ratio (18/20/24/28/40/48), two unrelated H2 sizes (24 and 40), and a chrome that has migrated wholly to dark navy — leaving the brand purple living only in photography, never as a chosen surface. The home is CTA-heavy: every band repeats a search/login/loyalty trio. The page asks for clicks before it makes you feel.

variants.name: Conservative refresh
variants.thesis: Same IA, refined tokens. The 1.25 modular type ladder, 6px corners, 64px section padding, and a guaranteed hero scrim do most of the work. Brand purple appears once in body — quiet, deliberate.
variants.fix: Same IA, modernised tokens. The 1.25 modular type ladder replaces six unrelated sizes; two H2 sizes collapse to one. 6px corners, 64px section padding, hero scrim guaranteed. Brand purple is exposed as a named accent token — once in body, deliberate, not decorative. The cheapest legibility win the brand has earned.

variants.name: Compositional shift
variants.thesis: Same palette, type, photography. Rearranged IA: the home opens with a single authored moment (one route, one offer) instead of the dense band-stack. Search and loyalty recede into one anchored utility shelf.
variants.fix: Same palette, type, photography. Different homepage thesis. The home opens with a single authored moment — one route, one offer, one image — not the dense band-stack of search/loyalty/destinations/upsell. Search and loyalty consolidate into one anchored utility shelf below the fold. The page reads as a brand statement, then a tool.

variants.name: Bold direction
variants.thesis: Push expressive from committed → drenched on one element. The captured photographic purple becomes a full emphasis band on the hero or a primary section ground; everything else stays brand-faithful.
variants.fix: Expressive pushed from committed → drenched on one element only. The captured photographic purple becomes a full emphasis band — a hero scrim that earns its purple, or a primary section ground. The rest of the page stays brand-faithful, so the move reads as commitment rather than rebrand. "Are we ready to be more distinctive?" answered visually.
